description: Thresholds derivados dos 7 cenários simulados na topologia m7i.xlarge

action_templates.scale_up: Scale up: increase active hosts -- load approaching observed maximum capacity
action_templates.scale_down: Scale down: reduce active hosts -- cluster oversized for current load
action_templates.energy_warning: Energy consumption above 66th percentile of simulated scenarios
action_templates.latency_high: Wait time elevated -- review scheduling policy
action_templates.cost_ok: Estimated cost within configured SLA budget
action_templates.cost_over: Estimated cost exceeds configured SLA budget
action_templates.completion_ok: Completion rate nominal -- no action required
action_templates.completion_low: Completion rate below expected -- investigate task failures
